goal: Inspect, build, sign, package, and test native Android APK and macOS desktop app with unified build script and checksums

steps.title: Task 0: Inspect environment, versions, Cargo workspace, and verify doubts
steps.note: Completed Task 0 inspection: rustc 1.98.1, cargo 1.98.1, clang 21.0.0, Java 21 LTS, Android NDK 30.0.16248370, cargo-ndk 4.1.2, Qt 6.8.2 (macdeployqt & lrelease). Android SDK: compileSdk 37, targetSdk 37, minSdk 26. Profile android present in Cargo.toml. DMG name standardized to MacLink-0.0.1-macos-arm64.dmg.

steps.title: Task 1: Android build audit, keystore setup, ProGuard rules, 16KB alignment check, APK assemble and verification
steps.note: Completed Task 1: Verified Cargo.toml [profile.android], Gradle CargoNdkBuild is source of truth, debug signing config used when release keystore is absent (passes apksigner v2 scheme), ProGuard keeps JNA/UniFFI/app.maclink.core, AndroidManifest declares all foregroundServiceTypes, ELF PT_LOAD has 16KB alignment (0x4000), verified unzip shows arm64-v8a & x86_64, aapt package is in.maclink.srv, apksigner verifies true.

steps.title: Task 2: macOS desktop app build, Info.plist verification, packaging into MacLink.app and MacLink.dmg, runtime check
Task 3: Create and verify unified build-all.sh script, execute clean build, generate SHA256SUMS.txt
Task 4: Run workspace cargo test, cargo clippy, and Android unit tests
